-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [ComentarioPublicacion] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_ComentarioPublicacion_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Publicacion_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Suscriptor_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @ComentarioPublicacionFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		ComentarioPublicacion_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @ComentarioPublicacionFilter (ComentarioPublicacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ComentarioPublicacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @ComentarioPublicacionFilter (ComentarioPublicacion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[ComentarioPublicacion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion]
		WHERE
			 (([ComentarioPublicacion].[Publicacion_Id] = @Publicacion_Id) OR (@Publicacion_Id = 0)) AND
         (([ComentarioPublicacion].[Suscriptor_Id] = @Suscriptor_Id) OR (@Suscriptor_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[ComentarioPublicacion].[Id],
		[ComentarioPublicacion].[Publicacion_Id],
		[ComentarioPublicacion].[Suscriptor_Id],
		[ComentarioPublicacion].[Fecha],
		[ComentarioPublicacion].[Comentario],
		[Publicacion].[Titulo] AS [PublicacionTitulo],
		[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico] AS [SuscriptorCorreoElectronico],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre] AS [SuscriptorNombre]
	FROM @ComentarioPublicacionFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion] 
			ON [ComentarioPublicacion].[Id] = filter.[ComentarioPublicacion_Id] 
			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Publicacion]
		ON [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion].[Publicacion_Id] = [dbo].[Publicacion].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		ON [dbo].[ComentarioPublicacion].[Suscriptor_Id] = [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] 

 
END

Name: rpt_ComentarioPublicacion_Index
